summary: This study tested if very short bouts of exercise, called one-minute exercise snacks, could help manage daytime blood sugar levels in adults with type 2 diabetes. Type 2 diabetes is a long-term condition where the body cannot properly process sugar for energy. The trial had 40 participants and was sponsored by Capital University of Physical Education and Sports, China. The status of this trial is Completed, with no phase listed.

facts.sponsor: Capital University of Physical Education and Sports, China
